Data Management Input and update employee data, including personal, payroll, and benefits information. review_candidates.title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenAPI
review_candidates.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About The Role We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to make building with ElevenLabs easier, from a developer's first API key to a successful production integration. Developer Growth owns the surfaces developers and their agents use: our SDKs, API, documentation and ElevenAPI dashboard. This role focuses on the dashboard and product flows, helping self-serve and enterprise developers get started, understand their usage and get more value from ElevenLabs. You will join a small, remote team and own features across frontend and backend. You will use direct user feedback and experiments to decide what to build, combining strong engineering with a careful eye for developer experience. Your Responsibilities Will Include Improving the ElevenAPI dashboard so developers can manage integrations and understand how their applications and agents use ElevenLabs. Streamlining onboarding, helping developers create API keys, get started with agents and reach their first successful integration. Designing and shipping experiments to improve activation, API key creation and self-serve subscriptions, then using the results to guide further changes. Owning features from discovery and design through frontend, backend, deployment and iteration, working closely with the team and learning from users. There is scope to grow into technical and team leadership over time, depending on your experience and impact. Requirements Strong full-stack engineering skills, with particular strength in frontend development and confidence building backend services and APIs. Strong product judgement and attention to UX, with evidence of making complex workflows intuitive for developers. Experience using user feedback, product data and experimentation to prioritise work and improve measurable outcomes. Independent, end-to-end ownership, clear communication and genuine enthusiasm for developer tools and developer experience. Prior generative audio experience is not required. Experience building developer-facing products, API dashboards or onboarding flows is particularly valuable. Previous technical or team leadership experience is a plus. Location: This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Supporting executives across a variety of functions, this person is the connective tissue that keeps calendars, communications, and initiatives running smoothly; and is accountable for the operational excellence that lets executives focus on growing the business instead of managing logistics. That means understanding that every missed meeting, delayed response, or travel hiccup sends ripples through the organization, and getting ahead of it before it does. We're looking for someone who thinks like a true partner, not a scheduler: someone who anticipates needs, understands how the pace and priorities of a scaling company shape an executive's day-to-day, and can turn competing demands into a calendar and workflow that just works. What Impact We’re Looking For You To Make Own calendar management across multiple executives with distinct personalities and working styles, creating seamless workflows that protect their time and give them breathing room to focus on what matters most. Build trusted partnerships with executives through clear, consistent communication - especially in explaining the "why" behind calendar changes so teams feel supported and cared for. Anticipate needs and solve problems proactively by reading between the lines, identifying which recurring meetings are moveable, and proposing solutions instead of waiting for direction. Leverage AI tools thoughtfully to amplify your own impact - drafting communications, scanning calendars for patterns, researching travel and onsite logistics - then reviewing and refining before it goes out (always 90% draft, then review). Partner across teams and functions - working with People Partners, team leads, our internal Events team, and external vendors - to coordinate department offsites, JLT onsites, travel logistics, and all the operational details that support leadership. What Experience We Need Approximately 5+ years of experience as an executive assistant in a fast-paced, scaling environment, with demonstrated success supporting multiple executives across different functions and personalities. Strong written and verbal communication skills - you draft correspondence, explain complex calendar decisions in writing, and communicate confidently across all levels. Proficiency with Google Suite (Gmail, Docs, Sheets), Slack, Notion, and comfort learning new tools quickly. You're calm under pressure. Executive support moves quickly, and you bring perspective, empathy, and a focus on outcomes even on the busiest days. Comfort with ambiguity and a growth mindset - this role is still evolving, and we're building the best practices together. You're someone who experiments, asks good questions, and isn't afraid to suggest better ways of doing things. We're hiring for people based in the Vancouver area who can travel to our North Vancouver office. More About Jane Jane is a founder-led, high-growth SaaS company with a remote-first team working across Canada, the US, and the UK, united by our mission to help the helpers.
